name: Card
description: A material design card: a panel with slightly rounded corners and a shadow. Useful for grouping related information in a visually distinct container.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget displayed inside the card.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the card.

properties.name: elevation
properties.description: The z-coordinate of the card, affecting the size of the shadow.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: The shape of the card's material, often a RoundedRectangleBorder.

properties.name: clipBehavior
properties.description: How to clip the content of the card.
